lines.t: Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Strip me naked, rip these layers, all these masks I wore
Thought I was a man, but project changed, I can't ignore
Self-reliance is a cage, self-will just feed the flame
False image in the mirror, Lord, dispose this hidden shame
Skin of my spirit, you burn the lies I hoard
Blind spots bleeding, truth each scar a secret store
Need for control dissolves, ego cracks under fire
Worldly definitions erased in revelation, I'm higher
Burn me in your flame, I'm falling deeper
Ascending higher
With every layer gone, my spirit walks through purifying fire
I am masculinity, reborn false kings Vaporize in smoke, made in your image
Now my soul finally awoke What man should be the world, always try to dictate
How to think, how to feel, how to move, how to operate
But your hands fill my flesh, leave no stone unturned
In the ashes of my pride, a new creation is learned
Surrender's not defeat, it's freedom from self-control
Let your refining wind invade, make this vessel whole
Strip me for your glory, break the script, day's show
Rebuild me in your presence, let my real be bold
Each scar testifies
Each blind spot's light revealed
In your image I stand
Every falsehood's killed
I'm unclothed, transformed
As your fire refines
Every broken vision restored by design
Burn me in your flame, I'm falling deeper
Ascending higher
With every layer gone, my spirit walks through purifying fire
Masculinity, freeborn false kings
Vaporizing smoke, painting your image
Now my soul finally awoke
So strip me naked, Lord
Let my heart be seen
In the blaze of your truth
I'm purified, made clean
No more false ideals
No more fear or pride
In Yahushua's revelation
I come alive
Thank you.
